name: comp-146

frames.best_why: The whole card is visible with logo, label and empty checkbox, and no cursor covers it.

tagline: A whole integration card you tick by clicking anywhere on it.
summary: A bordered row with a green lightning logo, a service name with a grey category suffix and a two-line description; a small checkbox sits at the top right and the entire card clicks as one target.
appearance: A wide dark rounded card with a thin border sits on a near-black stage. A green bolt logo leads, then "Supabase" in bold beside a smaller grey "(Database)", with a grey description line beneath, and a small empty checkbox floats at the top right.
behaviour: Hovering anywhere on the card lightens the checkbox and border; clicking anywhere ticks the checkbox and tints the card's border. The row acts as a single selectable option.
demo_content: Label "Supabase (Database)" and description "Sync auth, storage and Postgres from your Supabase project."
search_phrases: big choice card instead of checkbox
card with icon and tick box
use_when: Users pick one service or plan from a set and each option needs a logo, a name and a short explanation.
avoid_when: The card is fixed to Supabase copy and logo, and ticking only sets local checkbox state.
customise: No props: the SVG logo, service name, description and category suffix all live in the file, so a different integration means replacing them by hand.
weight_why: One card, a small inline SVG logo and a checkbox; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Label and description are tied to the checkbox and the logo is hidden, though the card itself has no focus outline.

polish_why: Clear card with a real logo and tidy text hierarchy; the checkbox is small beside it.
